name: How can I maintain my budget during an interior remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: How can I maintain my budget during an interior remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining your budget requires diligent planning and communication. Establish a realistic budget from the start and allocate a contingency fund, typically 10-15%, for unforeseen issues. Clearly define your project scope with your contractor and avoid making significant changes once work has begun, as these often incur additional costs. Make material selections early and stick to them. Regular check-ins with your contractor about spending and progress are crucial to staying on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain your budget by establishing a realistic plan, including a contingency fund, defining the scope clearly, and avoiding late changes.
